newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end down sharply in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end down sharply in thin trade.

text.p: Brazilian stocks closed sharply lower as the lack of local market-moving news, foreign investor apathy and one of the lowest daily volumes for the year combined to depress prices, brokers said.
"The market was almost dead," said John Carioba of Indusval brokerage. "There's nothing. Foreign investors are simply not interested."
The Sao Paulo bourse's Bovespa index of 52 most traded shares plunged 1,746 points to close at 60,281 points, down 2.82 percent from Friday, on thin volume of 223 million reais.
